title: THE MARSHAL WHO KEPT THE ORE HONEST
deck: Nine claim-jumpers have died by accident at Brannock Yard, the town loves the marshal who was always nearby, and in nine days the families of the dead cross the gap with cutting tugs.
shape: Six scenes across nine days: a ledger read against an air-plant load curve, a patrol skiff and a thumb beside a jammer, nine folders and a lamp rule that is also a payroll, a bakery counter, a hearing whose footings each needed someone else's yes, and six tugs at forty kilometres.

scenes.title: Nine Accidents
paragraphs: *Brannock Yard, air plant, third gantry · Tuesday, 06:40 · nine days before the Slack*

The air plant at Brannock was honest, and Illuminara respected it for that. Three thousand people drew on it, and it breathed back a curve with two humps a day where the shifts changed and everyone cycled the locks at once. She had spent two nights inside that curve, the way a locksmith spends an afternoon inside a lock, and had found nothing to certify against but a worn bearing.

The form also asked for the incident register, because a plant is only as honest as its count of the people it is breathing for. The register was short. Nine entries in six years. Nine strangers with Carrow Shoal registry tags, every one at the head of a shaft, every one within twelve minutes of a shift change, and in every entry the nearest craft was the marshal's patrol skiff.
Accidents are untidy. These had the same hand in them.

Marshal Tessaly Orr came along the gantry with a flask of tea in each fist, one of them meant for the certifier. She was tall and broad and moved without hurry, like someone who had never needed to hurry in order to arrive first. Her left eye had a faint silver ring around the iris. Three people said good morning to her in forty metres, and one of them, a child on a delivery sled, said it twice.

**Tessaly Orr**  
You read the register. Everyone who certifies the plant reads it. Most of them stop at the part where it's short.

**Illuminara**  
I stopped at the part where it's neat. Nine in six years, all at shaft heads, all at a shift change, all from Carrow Shoal. And yours is the nearest craft in every line.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Mine is the only craft.
She said it the way a person gives an address.

**Illuminara**  
I haven't come to accuse anyone, Marshal. I've come to understand a pattern, and so far all I can see of it is the part that wears a badge.
Orr drank some tea and considered her over the rim, with the patience of a woman who had been watched by cleverer people than this and outlasted them.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Ride a shift with me tonight. Shaft Nine changes crews at ten past ten. If you still have something to say at eleven, say it, and I'll answer it the way I'd want to be answered.
*She means that,* Illuminara thought, and the thought made the register worse and the woman harder to dislike, which was exactly the difficulty.

scenes.title: Shaft Nine
paragraphs: *Patrol skiff Plumb Line, off Shaft Nine · the same night, 22:02*

The skiff had two seats, a console scuffed by six years of the same elbows, and a view of the Yard as a scatter of lamps on a black rock. Orr flew it with two fingers. Below them stood the head of Shaft Nine, a cage housing and a claim lamp on a pole, and beside the housing a figure who was on no roster.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Ostrander Pell. Twice he's been down the Teague shaft, and twice I've sent him home with a warning I'd rather not have had to give. He doesn't mean to kill the crew. He means to take the lamp. The crew is what's in the way.

Through the scope Illuminara could see what he carried: a cutting pack, flat as a book, made to open a cage housing in one stroke. Her reading of its geometry was exact. What it meant for the six people due to ride down at ten past, with four hundred metres of dark beneath them, was an inference, and she held it as one.
On the console beside Orr's hand lay a flat black key. The jammer. A jammed fuse is a dead fuse. Orr's thumb rested next to it, not on it.

**Illuminara**  
Jam it and take him alive.

**Tessaly Orr**  
And tomorrow he's in my cooler, grinning, with his name on an Assize list eleven months away. I did it your way in year one. Two men killed Ama Teague and Hale Dorsey for a shaft. I fed them from the Yard's stores for eleven months, and the day the judge came the only witness had gone home to Carrow and would not come back. They walked. They were back by spring, with friends.
On the shaft head Pell set the pack against the housing and put his thumb to the arming key. The signal took four seconds to complete.

**Illuminara**  
I'm not asking you to be patient, Marshal. I'm asking for the one thing you've never had at this shaft. A witness.

**Tessaly Orr**  
You.

**Illuminara**  
If your thumb stays where it is, I will write down exactly what I saw. I'll say it at the Assize in eleven months, and to whoever asks me in nine days. It isn't an accusation. It's the only thing in this skiff I know how to do, and I would rather do it beside you than about you.
The silver ring in Orr's eye caught the console light.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Nine days. So you know about the Slack.

**Illuminara**  
I know the register. The rest I'm guessing.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Everyone in the Yard knows, and nobody says it to my face. When the rocks come within forty kilometres, the families cross with six tugs and cutting arms. I'd made my peace with standing on the gantry and letting them.

**Illuminara**  
And then the Yard is theirs for an afternoon. A dead marshal and an open town isn't an account, Tessaly. It's a second massacre with better manners.
Second three. Orr's thumb came down.

She was out of the hatch before the jam had finished singing in the console, one arm hooked round the shaft-head rail and the other round Pell's harness, and he left the housing like a sack lifted off a hook. The pack went dead in his fist. He looked at it, and then at her.

**Ostrander Pell**  
Where's the accident, Marshal?

**Tessaly Orr**  
Not tonight.
She said it flatly, and it was the most frightened thing Illuminara had heard her say.
Orr said nothing more until the lamps of the Yard were swinging up to meet them, Pell cuffed in the rear seat and breathing like a man doing sums.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Now I've a man in a cell, and three hundred miners who'll ask at breakfast why the one who cut Teague's cousin's line is eating at the town's expense. And no court to hand him to. That's the whole sum, Certifier. That's six years.

**Illuminara**  
Then we find out what it would take to have one before the Slack.

scenes.title: Nine Folders
paragraphs: *Marshal's office, Brannock Yard · Wednesday, 07:30 · eight days before the Slack*
The box on the desk held nine folders, and Orr set it in front of Illuminara the way you hand someone a sleeping animal.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Read them. Aloud, if you like. I've never heard them in another voice.

Each had a date, a name, a Carrow tag, a sketch of the shaft head in a draughtsman's clean hand, and two sheets headed in capitals. WHAT I KNEW. WHAT I DID NOT. Illuminara read all nine without hurrying. The first four were short and certain. By the sixth the second sheet had grown longer than the first. In the seventh, beside the name Joss Veck, stood one line in the margin: *Unsure. Pack in his hand. Did not see the fuse.*

**Illuminara**  
You keep these.

**Tessaly Orr**  
For the Assize. Whoever sits at it will want to know what I knew when I did it. I've written it down so that when a judge finally arrives she can sentence me with the paperwork complete.
Illuminara closed the seventh folder with some care.

**Illuminara**  
You've been filing your own indictment.

**Tessaly Orr**  
I've been holding a deposit. Somebody has to hold it until the person who should arrives. Ama Teague taught me nobody else was going to.

**Illuminara**  
Then I think I understand what I came to understand. The accidents were a court that didn't know it was a court. You investigated, you judged and you carried out the sentence, and you wrote it all down for someone to judge you afterwards. You built every part of a court except the other people.

**Tessaly Orr**  
A court is other people. That's the one part I can't build with my hands.
She said it dryly. Then she took the Yard's charter from her bottom drawer, its corners worn soft.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Article thirty-one. Every year I read it again and put it back.

It was a single paragraph. A Yard that could not reach an Assize within sixty days might convene a Rota of seven, drawn by lot from households not party to the dispute, to hear non-capital charges and hold the accused pending the Assize, under a Warden of another Yard presiding by relay.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Here's why not. Seven miners of Brannock either acquit Pell because half this Yard jumped a claim once, or convict him because they're afraid of me. The nearest Warden is Idris Vane at Sumner's Cut, seven hours away by buoy, so every question takes fourteen hours to come back. And a Rota can't touch a killing. It can't try Veck. It can't try me.
Illuminara spread the plant's load curve beside the incident register. The double hump of every shift change, and nine accidents sitting inside the humps like stones in a dry riverbed.

**Illuminara**  
Why do they come at the change?

**Tessaly Orr**  
Because that's when there's one person at the head of a shaft.

**Illuminara**  
And because of the lamp. A claim here lapses if its lamp stands dark seven minutes. At the change the outgoing minder rides up and the incoming one rides down, and for four or five minutes the pole is guarded by one tired person or none. Pell wasn't there for the crew. He was there to turn those minutes into a deed.

**Tessaly Orr**  
I tried an overlap in year two. Unpaid. The guild burned the notice on the Council steps.

**Illuminara**  
Unpaid, it's a tax on labour. Paid, it's the cheapest guard you'll ever hire. Keep the outgoing minder at the pole until the incoming lamp is lit beside it, and the lamp never goes dark. Forty-one working poles, two changes a day, one extra minder for ten minutes at each: eight hundred and twenty person-minutes, fourteen hours a day near enough, and the guild keeps its right to refuse any hour that isn't paid. Set it against the skiff, the cooler, the relay fees and the burials. It's a levy raised by a hair, and it comes out cheaper than the nine.
Orr looked at the figures for a long time. Her lips moved once, silently.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Six years. Ten minutes.
It was not a thing Illuminara could comfort her about, and she did not try.

**Tessaly Orr**  
That mends the lamp. It doesn't mend a man with a gun who doesn't care about lamps. You'd take my method off me and leave the Yard to whoever turns up armed.

**Illuminara**  
I'm not taking your method. I'm taking the part of it that can't be checked. What you know stays: who is coming, what they carry, where to stand. And the Yard keeps its force, with two keys on it instead of one. Ferris Oake, your night cage-foreman, holds a carbine licence he has never used. He rides the Plumb Line's second seat with a minder from the pole crews, a different one each night. The Yard's four carbines stay in the cage-brake locker, and it takes two keys: Oake's and the Council clerk's. You investigate. You run the jammer. You cannot alone decide that force is used, and you cannot use it. The next man with a pack meets a lit pole, a second witness and a hail before he meets a carbine.

**Tessaly Orr**  
And the verdict?

**Illuminara**  
Leaves your hands. At Pell's hearing you are a sworn investigator and nothing else. The clerk keeps the evidence, not you. Seven by lot, the Teague and Dorsey households excluded, anyone who ever filed against Carrow excused. A defender by lot, whose job is to beat your case if it can be beaten. A chair for Carrow, with the right to read every page and stop the hearing for a day. And your nine go to Vane today as a self-referral to the first Assize. Their own hearing, not Pell's.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Article thirty-one gives you the lots and the Warden. It doesn't give you a defender or a stop right. Who says those exist?

**Illuminara**  
Nobody yet, and that's the point. These are proposals. The Council adopts the recusals and the custody rule tonight, or it doesn't. Vane orders the defender and the stop right by relay, or narrows them, or refuses. Carrow's chair is Carrow's to accept; if it won't sit in it, the hearing doesn't pretend. The guild's steward signs the paid overlap, or it stays a notice on the steps. Every one of those is a yes that somebody other than us has to say.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Vane will cut something.

**Illuminara**  
Then it's cut, and we find out whether the rest holds.

**Tessaly Orr**  
That is a good arrangement for everyone except the woman who has to hand it over.

**Illuminara**  
Yes.
Orr sat down. For a while the only sound in the office was the clock.

**Tessaly Orr**  
I wanted that. That's the dreadful part, Certifier. For six years I have wanted to be made to hand it over.
She lifted the box, held it a moment as one holds something before passing it, and set it on the corner of the desk for the clerk.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Draw the lots.

scenes.title: A Loaf at the Door
paragraphs: *Abara's bakery, Brannock Yard · Thursday, 05:50 · seven days before the Slack*

Moss Abara's apprentice had flour to the elbows and a sled lamp with a Carrow tag clipped under the paint. Illuminara had noticed the tag on Tuesday, and had noticed the apprentice noticing her notice it.

**Illuminara**  
You're counting the lamps.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Forty-one. And the skiff's rounds, and which doors she locks. My family wanted to know where she'd be on the day.
She did not stop kneading.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Joss Veck was my father. You'll have read his folder.

**Illuminara**  
I have.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Then you know more than I do.
Her hands slowed.

**Tamsin Veck**  
She buys a loaf from me every morning. Pays double. Calls me Miss Veck and never says why. For a month I thought it was manners.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Here's what you're going to ask. You'll ask my family to wait for a trial held by the town that loves her, in front of seven miners who eat her bread, presided over by a Warden who has never smelled this air. Nobody gave my father a lottery. He got a seal that went wrong at a shift change and a line in a register that says accident. You're asking us for patience, and patience is what we have been sold for six years.

**Illuminara**  
No. I don't want your patience. I want to put three things in your hands, and you may refuse every one. A chair in the Rota room, with the right to stop the hearing for a day and ask. A key to the record: all nine folders, copied today for whoever your families name. And the decision on whether the tugs cross armed belongs to your families. Not to me. Not to her.

**Tamsin Veck**  
And if your Rota hands Pell a medal?

**Illuminara**  
Then you will have read it, and sat in the room where it happened, and you'll have a record. That is more than the dead were given.
The door chimed. Orr stood in it in her marshal's coat, holding a single folder in both hands like a tray. She did not come in until Tamsin looked up.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Miss Veck. This is your father's. The other eight are being copied for whoever you name. This is the one I'd rather you read before anyone tells you what's in it.
Tamsin wiped her hands on her apron, one and then the other, and took it. She read the first sheet. She read the second. The margin took longer.

**Tamsin Veck**  
You were unsure and you did it anyway.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Yes. I won't tell you what it cost me. It's no use to you.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Don't ask me to forgive you.

**Tessaly Orr**  
I'm not asking.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Then what is this?

**Tessaly Orr**  
A paper you can hold me to.
Tamsin closed the folder. She went back behind the counter, wrapped the Marshal's loaf, chalked the price on the paper, double, and set it down between them.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Yours.
It was not forgiveness. It was a transaction, and Illuminara understood that it was the first honest one the two of them had ever had.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Hesk Tolliver. He mapped our claims before my father was born. If the chair is real, he sits in it, and he comes across on Friday's freight to say whether it is.

scenes.title: Fourteen Hours a Question
paragraphs: *Council hall, Brannock Yard · Tuesday, 03:40 · two days before the Slack*

A hearing at fourteen hours a question had a rhythm Illuminara had not expected: long stillness, a flurry, long stillness. Every footing under it had been poured by someone with the power to refuse. The guild steward, Dova Quill, who had burned the last notice on the Council steps, had signed the paid overlap on Wednesday night, minuting that any minder could still decline an unpaid hour. The Council had adopted the recusals and the custody rule by six votes to three, and raised the levy by a fraction rather than take a coin from the skiff, the cooler, the relay fees or the burials. Vane had ordered the defender by relay and struck one clause the charter would not bear: Carrow's stop right was one day, once, not whenever it liked. Orr, asked if she would fight for the larger clause, had said no.

The lots had returned a shaft-timber carpenter, a cook, two cage operators, a retired lamp-minder, a nurse and the Yard's only dentist. Pell had asked for his defender the moment the charge was read. She was Odalie Kray, a cage-brake mechanic who disliked her client on sight and had a professional's contempt for a bad argument. She had told him to say nothing about the fuse. He had said it anyway, in his own words, and refused to sign the line that was not his. The clerk, Wynne Halloway, kept the evidence in a locked cabinet with the key on a cord round her neck. Orr did not so much as touch the cabinet.

Hesk Tolliver, who had come across on Friday's freight, sat in the chair for Carrow, an old surveyor with a cane across his knees. He had walked the cage-brake locker on Monday and found it took two keys. He had stopped the hearing once, for a day, to read the fourth folder twice. Tamsin had gone home on Saturday's freight with nine copies in a sealed case and a loaf nobody had asked her to bake. Since Thursday the pole at Shaft Nine had stood lit through every change, two minders side by side talking about football, and the register had no new line.
Vane's last answer had come at 03:31. Wynne Halloway read it standing.

**Idris Vane, by relay**  
On the evidence before the Rota. Attempted murder of the cage crew: not proven. The jammer log shows the Marshal's jam preceded the completion of any arming signal, and the Rota cannot find that Ostrander Pell armed the fuse. Attempted taking of a claim by explosive: proven, by the pack, by the roster in his pocket and by his own statement, which the defender has confirmed was given after counsel and without inducement. He is held pending the Assize. The Rota is thanked, and so is the defender, whose argument on the fuse was the better one.

Orr sat in the investigator's chair and did not move. Six years of her work lay inside that finding, and a stranger in a mechanic's apron had won a point against her within it. Illuminara watched her watch it. Something in the Marshal's shoulders came down a centimetre.

**Ostrander Pell**  
Marshal. You said not tonight. Is it tomorrow?

**Tessaly Orr**  
No.

**Ostrander Pell**  
Then I'll take the cell.

**Odalie Kray**  
For the record, I still think he's a lamp thief.

**Hesk Tolliver**  
For the record, so do I. But I've read nine folders and a transcript in four days, and I will sign that this was a hearing.
He signed. His hand was steady, and the pen was Wynne Halloway's, because he had left his own in Carrow.

**Hesk Tolliver**  
The families vote tomorrow night by relay. I'll tell them what I saw, and what the locker takes to open. I won't tell them what to do.

scenes.title: The Slack
paragraphs: *Gantry one, Brannock Yard · Thursday, 14:00 · the Slack*

At forty kilometres Carrow Shoal was a bright rock with six lit tugs sliding off it, their cutting arms unfolded like the legs of insects. The rocks would hold that distance for six hours. The Yard stood in its suits along gantry one: Council, lamp-minders, Hesk Tolliver with his cane, a child on a delivery sled who had been told to go home and had declined. Ferris Oake stood at the gantry's foot with a carbine on his shoulder and a minder beside him. Orr was there with no sidearm and Wynne Halloway on her left, and a lamp in the Marshal's hand because someone had insisted that nobody stand on gantry one in the dark.
The lead tug hailed. The voice was Tamsin Veck's.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Brannock Yard, this is Carrow Shoal. The families have voted. I'll read it once.

**Tamsin Veck**  
One. We have read all nine. Hesk Tolliver keeps the copies in the Carrow Registry, where no marshal can lose them. Two. The Rota's finding on Pell stands as the first of its kind, and the families keep a chair in that room for good. Three. Tessaly Orr stands before the first Assize on all nine, and until then she walks no shaft alone and carries nothing but the jammer. Force at Brannock belongs to Oake's watch and the two-key locker, which Hesk watched Oake and the Council clerk open together, and which no one person can open. Four. If any of this breaks, we cross again, and next time we won't ring first.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Accepted. All four. I'd have written the fourth myself.
On the lead tug the cutting arms folded, one by one, and then, slowly, the other five.

**Tamsin Veck**  
I haven't forgiven her. I want that written down.

**Illuminara**  
It's written. It was in the Rota record before you said it.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Good. We'll dock for the afternoon. Someone tell Hesk Tolliver he can stop holding that gantry rail like it owes him money.
Illuminara certified the plant that evening and signed the form with a note about the bearing.

At ten past ten Shaft Nine changed crews. Two lamps stood on the pole for ten minutes, side by side, and the minders talked about nothing in particular until the cage came up. Orr watched from the rail with a second person beside her, because the families' third term required it and she had signed it.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Eleven months to the Assize.

**Illuminara**  
I'll be there. In the second row, if they allow it.

**Tessaly Orr**  
They don't have a second row.

**Illuminara**  
Then I'll bring a chair.
Below them the lamp burned, and in the register, under accidents, the line stayed empty.

critic_line: A marshal's buried sabotage and a claim-jumper's coherent fear become a paid, two-key, family-authored protection system that keeps the ore moving without erasing nine deaths or handing any one person the gun.

literary_score.method: READER_APPEAL_R1 · exact 50/50 mean of independent GPT and Claude judgments
shared_strengths: Strong dialogue-driven moral setup (a marshal-as-secret-court, institutional redesign) with a satisfying, humane resolution and memorable images like the nine folders and the double-priced loaf. Drawbacks: procedural policy exposition in long speeches, many names, and tidy conflict resolution that may feel too smooth.

The central moral problem is immediately legible yet genuinely hard, and the dialogue turns procedural safeguards into suspense and character. Orr's hunger to be constrained gives the institutional resolution emotional weight. The long mid-story design monologue may tax some readers, but the Slack payoff is earned, humane, and memorable.
shared_reservations: Unpaid, it's a tax on labour. Paid, it's the cheapest guard you'll ever hire. Keep the outgoing minder at the pole until the incoming lamp is lit beside it, and the lamp never goes dark.
Ferris Oake, your night cage-foreman, holds a carbine licence he has never used. He rides the Plumb Line's second seat with a minder from the pole crews

translation_sl.title: MARŠALKA, KI JE OHRANILA POŠTENOST RUDE
translation_sl.deck: Devet prisvojiteljev rudarskih pravic je po nesreči umrlo v Brannock Yardu, mesto ljubi maršalko, ki je bila vedno v bližini, čez devet dni pa družine mrtvih prečkajo vrzel z rezalnimi vlačilci.
translation_sl.shape: Šest prizorov v devetih dneh: knjiga evidenc, brana ob krivulji obremenitve zračnega obrata, patruljni čolnič in palec ob motilniku, devet map in pravilo o svetilki, ki je tudi obračun plač, pekovski pult, zaslišanje, katerega vsak temelj je potreboval pritrditev nekoga drugega, in šest vlačilcev na razdalji štiridesetih kilometrov.

scenes.title: Devet nesreč
paragraphs: *Brannock Yard, zračni obrat, tretji mostovž · torek, 06:40 · devet dni pred Zatišjem*

Zračni obrat v Brannocku je bil pošten in Illuminara ga je zaradi tega spoštovala. Iz njega je zajemalo tri tisoč ljudi, nazaj pa je dihal krivuljo z dvema grbinama na dan, kjer so se menjavale izmene in so vsi hkrati poganjali zapore. Dve noči je preživela znotraj te krivulje, tako kot ključavničar preživi popoldne v notranjosti ključavnice, in ni našla ničesar, zaradi česar bi lahko odklonila potrdilo, razen obrabljenega ležaja.

Obrazec je zahteval tudi register incidentov, kajti obrat je pošten le toliko, kolikor je pošteno njegovo štetje ljudi, za katere diha. Register je bil kratek. Devet vpisov v šestih letih. Devet tujcev z registrskimi oznakami Carrow Shoala, vsak pri ustju jaška, vsak v dvanajstih minutah od menjave izmene, pri vsakem vpisu pa je bilo najbližje plovilo maršalkin patruljni čolnič.
Nesreče so neurejene. V teh je bila ista roka.

Maršalka Tessaly Orr je prišla po mostovžu s čutaro čaja v vsaki pesti; ena je bila namenjena potrjevalki. Bila je visoka in široka ter se je gibala brez naglice, kakor nekdo, ki mu nikoli ni bilo treba hiteti, da bi prispel prvi. Okrog šarenice njenega levega očesa je bil rahel srebrn obroč. V štiridesetih metrih so ji trije ljudje zaželeli dobro jutro, eden od njih, otrok na dostavnih saneh, pa dvakrat.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Prebrali ste register. Prebere ga vsak, ki potrjuje obrat. Večina se ustavi pri tem, da je kratek.

**Illuminara**  
Ustavila sem se pri tem, da je urejen. Devet v šestih letih, vsi pri ustjih jaškov, vsi ob menjavi izmene, vsi iz Carrow Shoala. Vaše plovilo pa je najbližje v vsaki vrstici.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Moje je edino plovilo.
Rekla je tako, kakor človek pove naslov.

**Illuminara**  
Nisem prišla nikogar obtoževat, maršalka. Prišla sem razumet vzorec, za zdaj pa v njem vidim samo del, ki nosi značko.
Orr je popila nekaj čaja in jo opazovala čez rob, s potrpežljivostjo ženske, ki so jo gledali že pametnejši ljudje od te in jih je vse preživela.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Nocoj se peljite z menoj eno izmeno. Jašek Devet menja posadko deset čez deset. Če boste ob enajstih še vedno imeli kaj povedati, povejte, jaz pa bom odgovorila tako, kot bi želela, da odgovorijo meni.
*To misli resno,* je pomislila Illuminara, in zaradi te misli je bil register še hujši, žensko pa je bilo še težje ne marati, kar je bila natanko težava.

scenes.title: Jašek Devet
paragraphs: *Patruljni čolnič Plumb Line, ob Jašku Devet · isto noč, 22:02*

Čolnič je imel dva sedeža, konzolo, zdrgnjeno od šestih let istih komolcev, in pogled na Yard kot na raztresene svetilke na črni skali. Orr ga je upravljala z dvema prstoma. Pod njima je stalo ustje Jaška Devet, ohišje kletke in lastniška svetilka na drogu, ob ohišju pa postava, ki je ni bilo na nobenem seznamu.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Ostrander Pell. Dvakrat se je spustil v Teagueov jašek in dvakrat sem ga poslala domov z opozorilom, ki bi ga raje ne bila prisiljena dati. Posadke noče ubiti. Hoče vzeti svetilko. Posadka je tisto, kar mu stoji na poti.

Skozi daljnogled je Illuminara videla, kaj nosi: rezalni paket, ploščat kakor knjiga, narejen tako, da z enim udarcem odpre ohišje kletke. Njeno branje njegove geometrije je bilo natančno. Kaj pomeni za šest ljudi, ki bi se morali deset čez deset spustiti v štiristo metrov teme, je bil sklep, in kot takšnega ga je tudi obdržala.
Na konzoli ob Orrini roki je ležal ploščat črn ključ. Motilnik. Motena vžigalna naprava je mrtva vžigalna naprava. Orrin palec je počival poleg njega, ne na njem.

**Illuminara**  
Onemogočite ga in ga primite živega.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Jutri pa bo v moji hladilnici sedel z nasmeškom in svojim imenom na seznamu Sodišča, ki pride čez enajst mesecev. V prvem letu sem ravnala po vaše. Dva moška sta zaradi jaška ubila Amo Teague in Hala Dorseyja. Enajst mesecev sem ju hranila iz zalog Yarda, ko je sodnica prišla, pa se je edina priča že vrnila domov v Carrow in se ni hotela vrniti. Odhodila sta. Do pomladi sta bila nazaj, s prijatelji.
Pri ustju jaška je Pell prislonil paket ob ohišje in položil palec na sprožilni ključ. Signal je za dokončanje potreboval štiri sekunde.

**Illuminara**  
Ne prosim vas za potrpežljivost, maršalka. Prosim za edino stvar, ki je pri tem jašku še nikoli niste imeli. Pričo.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Vas.

**Illuminara**  
Če vaš palec ostane tam, kjer je, bom zapisala natanko to, kar sem videla. Povedala bom na Sodišču čez enajst mesecev in vsakomur, ki me bo vprašal čez devet dni. To ni obtožba. To je edino, kar znam narediti v tem čolniču, in raje bi to naredila ob vas kakor o vas.
Srebrni obroč v Orrinem očesu je ujel svetlobo konzole.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Devet dni. Torej veste za Zatišje.

**Illuminara**  
Poznam register. Ostalo ugibam.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Vsi v Yardu vedo in nihče mi tega ne pove v obraz. Ko se skali približata na štirideset kilometrov, družine prečkajo vrzel s šestimi vlačilci in rezalnimi rokami. Sprijaznila sem se, da bom stala na mostovžu in jim pustila.

**Illuminara**  
Potem pa je Yard za eno popoldne njihov. Mrtva maršalka in odprto mesto nista obračun, Tessaly. To je drugi pokol z boljšimi manirami.
Tretja sekunda. Orrin palec se je spustil.

Iz lopute je bila, še preden je motnja nehala peti v konzoli, z eno roko ovita okrog ograje ustja jaška, z drugo pa okrog Pellovega pasu; zapustil je ohišje kakor vreča, dvignjena s kavlja. Paket mu je v pesti ugasnil. Pogledal ga je, nato pa njo.

**Ostrander Pell**  
Kje je nesreča, maršalka?

**Tessaly Orr**  
Nocoj je ne bo.
Rekla je brezizrazno in to je bila najbolj prestrašena stvar, ki jo je Illuminara slišala izreči.
Orr ni rekla ničesar več, dokler se svetilke Yarda niso dvigovale proti njima, Pell pa je vklenjen na zadnjem sedežu dihal kakor človek, ki računa.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Zdaj imam človeka v celici in tristo rudarjev, ki bodo pri zajtrku spraševali, zakaj tisti, ki je prerezal vod Teagueovega bratranca, jé na stroške mesta. In nobenega sodišča, ki bi mu ga predala. To je celoten seštevek, potrjevalka. To je šest let.

**Illuminara**  
Potem ugotoviva, kaj bi bilo potrebno, da ga dobimo pred Zatišjem.

scenes.title: Devet map
paragraphs: *Maršalkina pisarna, Brannock Yard · sreda, 07:30 · osem dni pred Zatišjem*
V škatli na mizi je bilo devet map in Orr jo je postavila pred Illuminara tako, kakor človek nekomu izroči spečo žival.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Preberite jih. Naglas, če želite. Nikoli jih še nisem slišala z drugim glasom.

Vsaka je imela datum, ime, oznako Carrowa, skico ustja jaška v čisti roki risarja in dva lista z naslovoma z velikimi črkami. KAJ SEM VEDELA. ČESA NISEM VEDELA. Illuminara je vseh devet prebrala brez naglice. Prve štiri so bile kratke in gotove. Pri šesti je drugi list postal daljši od prvega. V sedmi je ob imenu Joss Veck na robu stala ena vrstica: *Negotova. Paket v njegovi roki. Vžigalne naprave nisem videla.*

**Illuminara**  
To hranite.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Za Sodišče. Kdor bo sedel na njem, bo hotel vedeti, kaj sem vedela, ko sem to storila. Zapisala sem, da me bo sodnica, ko končno pride, lahko obsodila s popolno dokumentacijo.
Illuminara je sedmo mapo skrbno zaprla.

**Illuminara**  
Vlagali ste lastno obtožnico.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Hranila sem polog. Nekdo ga mora hraniti, dokler ne pride oseba, ki bi morala. Ama Teague me je naučila, da ga ne bo nihče drug.

**Illuminara**  
Potem mislim, da razumem, kar sem prišla razumet. Nesreče so bile sodišče, ki ni vedelo, da je sodišče. Preiskovali ste, sodili in izvršili kazen, vse pa zapisali za nekoga, ki bi pozneje sodil vam. Zgradili ste vse dele sodišča razen drugih ljudi.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Sodišče so drugi ljudje. To je edini del, ki ga ne morem zgraditi z rokami.
Povedala je suho. Nato je iz spodnjega predala vzela listino Yarda z od uporabe zmehčanimi vogali.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Enaintrideseti člen. Vsako leto ga znova preberem in spravim nazaj.

Bil je en sam odstavek. Yard, ki Sodišča ne more doseči v šestdesetih dneh, lahko skliče sedemčlansko Roto, izžrebano iz gospodinjstev, ki niso udeležena v sporu, da obravnava kazniva dejanja, za katera ni zagrožena smrtna kazen, in obtoženca zadrži do Sodišča, pod vodstvom skrbnika drugega Yarda, ki predseduje po relejni zvezi.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Zato ne. Sedem rudarjev Brannocka Pella bodisi oprosti, ker si je polovica tega Yarda nekoč prisvojila pravico, bodisi obsodi, ker se me bojijo. Najbližji skrbnik je Idris Vane v Sumner's Cutu, sedem ur stran z bojo, zato vsako vprašanje potrebuje štirinajst ur za odgovor. Rota pa se ne sme dotakniti uboja. Ne more soditi Vecku. Ne more soditi meni.
Illuminara je poleg registra incidentov razgrnila krivuljo obremenitve obrata. Dvojna grbina vsake menjave izmene in devet nesreč, ki so sedele v grbinah kakor kamni v suhi strugi.

**Illuminara**  
Zakaj pridejo ob menjavi?

**Tessaly Orr**  
Ker je takrat ob ustju jaška samo en človek.

**Illuminara**  
In zaradi svetilke. Pravica tukaj ugasne, če njena svetilka stoji temna sedem minut. Ob menjavi se prejšnji paznik pelje gor, novi pa dol, in štiri ali pet minut drog varuje en utrujen človek ali nihče. Pell ni bil tam zaradi posadke. Tam je bil, da bi te minute spremenil v listino.

**Tessaly Orr**  
V drugem letu sem poskusila s prekrivanjem. Neplačanim. Ceh je obvestilo zažgal na stopnicah Sveta.

**Illuminara**  
Neplačano je davek na delo. Plačano je najcenejše varovanje, ki ga boste kdaj najeli. Prejšnji paznik naj ostane ob drogu, dokler poleg njegove ne zasveti svetilka prihajajočega, in svetilka nikoli ne ugasne. Enainštirideset delujočih drogov, dve menjavi na dan, en dodatni paznik po deset minut pri vsaki: osemsto dvajset človek-minut, skoraj natanko štirinajst ur na dan, ceh pa ohrani pravico zavrniti vsako neplačano uro. Postavite to nasproti čolniču, hladilnici, relejnim pristojbinam in pogrebom. Dajatev se zviša za las in izide ceneje od devetih.
Orr je številke dolgo gledala. Ustnice so se ji enkrat neslišno premaknile.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Šest let. Deset minut.
To ni bilo nekaj, glede česar bi jo Illuminara lahko potolažila, in tega ni poskušala.

**Tessaly Orr**  
To popravi svetilko. Ne popravi oboroženega človeka, ki mu za svetilke ni mar. Vzeli bi mi mojo metodo in Yard prepustili vsakomur, ki pride oborožen.

**Illuminara**  
Ne jemljem vam metode. Jemljem ji del, ki ga ni mogoče preveriti. Kar veste, ostane: kdo prihaja, kaj nosi, kje stati. Yard pa ohrani svojo silo, le da ima dva ključa namesto enega. Ferris Oake, vaš nočni nadzornik kletk, ima dovoljenje za karabinko, ki je še nikoli ni uporabil. Na drugem sedežu Plumb Lina se pelje z enim od paznikov drogov, vsak večer drugim. Štiri karabinke Yarda ostanejo v omarici zavor kletke, za odprtje pa sta potrebna dva ključa: Oakeov in ključ tajnice Sveta. Vi preiskujete. Vi upravljate motilnik. Ne morete sami odločiti, da se uporabi sila, in je ne morete uporabiti. Naslednji človek s paketom sreča prižgan drog, drugo pričo in poziv, preden sreča karabinko.

**Tessaly Orr**  
In razsodba?

**Illuminara**  
Zapusti vaše roke. Na Pellovem zaslišanju ste zaprisežena preiskovalka in nič drugega. Dokaze hrani tajnica, ne vi. Sedem po žrebu, gospodinjstvi Teague in Dorsey sta izključeni, vsak, ki je kdaj vložil prijavo proti Carrowu, izločen. Zagovornik po žrebu, čigar naloga je premagati vaš primer, če ga je mogoče premagati. Stol za Carrow, s pravico prebrati vsako stran in zaslišanje ustaviti za en dan. Vaših devet pa gre danes Vanu kot samoprijava prvemu Sodišču. Njihovo lastno zaslišanje, ne Pellovo.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Enaintrideseti člen vam daje žreb in skrbnika. Ne daje vam zagovornika ali pravice ustavitve. Kdo pravi, da to obstaja?

**Illuminara**  
Za zdaj nihče, in prav to je bistvo. To so predlogi. Svet nocoj sprejme izločitve in pravilo pridržanja ali pa ne. Vane po releju odredi zagovornika in pravico ustavitve, ju zoži ali zavrne. Carrowov stol mora sprejeti Carrow; če ne sede nanj, se zaslišanje ne pretvarja. Cehovski zaupnik podpiše plačano prekrivanje ali pa ostane obvestilo na stopnicah. Vsak od teh je pritrditev, ki jo mora izreči nekdo drug kot midve.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Vane bo nekaj odrezal.

**Illuminara**  
Potem je odrezano in ugotoviva, ali preostalo drži.

**Tessaly Orr**  
To je dobra ureditev za vse razen za žensko, ki jo mora predati.

**Illuminara**  
Da.
Orr je sedla. Nekaj časa je bila edini zvok v pisarni ura.

**Tessaly Orr**  
To sem želela. To je grozni del, potrjevalka. Šest let sem želela, da bi me prisilili to predati.
Dvignila je škatlo, jo za trenutek držala tako, kakor človek nekaj drži pred predajo, nato pa jo postavila na vogal mize za tajnico.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Izžrebajte jih.

scenes.title: Hlebec pri vratih
paragraphs: *Abaraova pekarna, Brannock Yard · četrtek, 05:50 · sedem dni pred Zatišjem*

Vajenka Mossa Abare je bila do komolcev v moki, pod barvo svetilke na saneh pa je imela pripeto oznako Carrowa. Illuminara je oznako opazila v torek in opazila tudi, da je vajenka opazila njen pogled.

**Illuminara**  
Štejete svetilke.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Enainštirideset. In obhode čolnička in katera vrata zaklepa. Moja družina je želela vedeti, kje bo tistega dne.
Ni nehala mesiti.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Joss Veck je bil moj oče. Prebrali ste njegovo mapo.

**Illuminara**  
Sem.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Potem veste več kakor jaz.
Roke so se ji upočasnile.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Vsako jutro pri meni kupi hlebec. Plača dvojno. Kliče me gospodična Veck in nikoli ne pove zakaj. Mesec dni sem mislila, da so to manire.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Takole me boste prosili. Prosili boste mojo družino, naj počaka na sojenje, ki ga vodi mesto, ki jo ljubi, pred sedmimi rudarji, ki jedo njen kruh, pod predsedovanjem skrbnika, ki tega zraka še nikoli ni zavohal. Mojemu očetu nihče ni dal žreba. Dobil je tesnilo, ki je odpovedalo ob menjavi izmene, in vrstico v registru, ki pravi nesreča. Prosite nas za potrpežljivost, potrpežljivost pa je tisto, kar so nam prodajali šest let.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Nočem vaše potrpežljivosti. Tri stvari želim položiti v vaše roke, vsako pa lahko zavrnete. Stol v sobi Rote, s pravico ustaviti zaslišanje za en dan in vprašati. Ključ do spisa: vseh devet map, danes prepisanih za tistega, ki ga imenujejo vaše družine. Odločitev, ali vlačilci prečkajo oboroženi, pa pripada vašim družinam. Ne meni. Ne njej.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Kaj pa če vaša Rota Pella odlikuje?

**Illuminara**  
Potem boste to prebrali, sedeli v sobi, kjer se je zgodilo, in imeli zapis. To je več, kakor so dobili mrtvi.
Vrata so zazvonila. V njih je stala Orr v maršalkinem plašču in v obeh rokah držala eno samo mapo kakor pladenj. Ni vstopila, dokler Tamsin ni dvignila pogleda.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Gospodična Veck. To je mapa vašega očeta. Drugih osem prepisujejo za tistega, ki ga boste imenovali. To je tista, za katero bi raje videla, da jo preberete, preden vam kdo pove, kaj je v njej.
Tamsin si je obrisala roke v predpasnik, najprej eno, nato drugo, in jo vzela. Prebrala je prvi list. Prebrala je drugega. Za rob je potrebovala dlje.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Niste bili prepričani, pa ste vseeno storili.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Da. Ne bom vam povedala, kaj me je to stalo. Vam nič ne koristi.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Ne prosite me, naj vam odpustim.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Ne prosim.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Kaj je potem to?

**Tessaly Orr**  
Papir, po katerem me lahko držite za besedo.
Tamsin je mapo zaprla. Vrnila se je za pult, zavila maršalkin hlebec, na papir s kredo napisala dvojno ceno in ga položila mednju.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Vaš.
To ni bilo odpuščanje. Bila je transakcija in Illuminara je razumela, da je bila prva poštena, kar sta jih kdaj imeli.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Hesk Tolliver. Naše pravice je kartiral, preden se je rodil moj oče. Če je stol resničen, bo na njem sedel on, s petkovim tovornim plovilom pa bo prišel povedat, ali je resničen.

scenes.title: Štirinajst ur za vprašanje
paragraphs: *Dvorana Sveta, Brannock Yard · torek, 03:40 · dva dni pred Zatišjem*

Zaslišanje, pri katerem je vsako vprašanje trajalo štirinajst ur, je imelo ritem, ki ga Illuminara ni pričakovala: dolgo mirovanje, naval, dolgo mirovanje. Vsak temelj pod njim je vlil nekdo, ki je imel moč zavrniti. Cehovska zaupnica Dova Quill, ki je zažgala zadnje obvestilo na stopnicah Sveta, je v sredo zvečer podpisala plačano prekrivanje in v zapisnik dodala, da lahko vsak paznik še vedno zavrne neplačano uro. Svet je izločitve in pravilo pridržanja sprejel s šestimi glasovi proti trem ter dajatev zvišal za drobec, namesto da bi vzel en sam kovanec čolniču, hladilnici, relejnim pristojbinam ali pogrebom. Vane je po releju odredil zagovornika in črtal določbo, ki je listina ni prenesla: Carrowova pravica ustavitve je bila en dan, enkrat, ne kadar koli bi hotel. Ko so Orr vprašali, ali se bo borila za širšo določbo, je rekla ne.

Žreb je vrnil tesarja za jamski les, kuharico, dva operaterja kletk, upokojenega paznika svetilke, medicinsko sestro in edinega zobozdravnika v Yardu. Pell je zahteval zagovornico v trenutku, ko je bila obtožba prebrana. Bila je Odalie Kray, mehaničarka zavore kletke, ki svojega klienta ni marala že na pogled in je s poklicnim prezirom gledala na slab argument. Rekla mu je, naj o vžigalni napravi ne pove ničesar. On je vseeno povedal s svojimi besedami in ni hotel podpisati vrstice, ki ni bila njegova. Tajnica Wynne Halloway je dokaze hranila v zaklenjeni omari s ključem na vrvici okrog vratu. Orr se omare ni niti dotaknila.

Hesk Tolliver, ki je prišel s petkovim tovornim plovilom, je sedel na stolu za Carrow, star geodet s palico prek kolen. V ponedeljek je pregledal omarico zavor kletke in ugotovil, da sta potrebna dva ključa. Zaslišanje je enkrat ustavil za en dan, da je četrto mapo prebral dvakrat. Tamsin je s sobotnim tovornim plovilom odšla domov z devetimi kopijami v zapečatenem kovčku in hlebcem, ki ga ni nihče naročil. Od četrtka je drog pri Jašku Devet ostal prižgan skozi vsako menjavo, dva paznika sta drug ob drugem govorila o nogometu, register pa ni dobil nove vrstice.
Vanov zadnji odgovor je prišel ob 03:31. Wynne Halloway ga je prebrala stoje.

**Idris Vane, po releju**  
O dokazih pred Roto. Poskus umora posadke kletke: ni dokazano. Dnevnik motilnika kaže, da je maršalkina motnja nastopila pred dokončanjem kakršnega koli sprožilnega signala, in Rota ne more ugotoviti, da je Ostrander Pell oborožil vžigalno napravo. Poskus prisvojitve rudarske pravice z razstrelivom: dokazano s paketom, seznamom posadke v njegovem žepu in njegovo lastno izjavo, za katero je zagovornica potrdila, da je bila podana po posvetu in brez napeljevanja. Pridržan je do Sodišča. Rota prejema zahvalo, prav tako zagovornica, katere argument glede vžigalne naprave je bil boljši.

Orr je sedela na stolu preiskovalke in se ni premaknila. Šest let njenega dela je bilo znotraj te ugotovitve in neznanka v mehaničarskem predpasniku je znotraj nje dobila točko proti njej. Illuminara jo je opazovala, kako to opazuje. Nekaj v maršalkinih ramenih se je spustilo za centimeter.

**Ostrander Pell**  
Maršalka. Rekli ste, da nocoj ne. Je jutri?

**Tessaly Orr**  
Ne.

**Ostrander Pell**  
Potem vzamem celico.

**Odalie Kray**  
Za zapisnik še vedno mislim, da je tat svetilk.

**Hesk Tolliver**  
Za zapisnik tudi jaz. Toda v štirih dneh sem prebral devet map in prepis ter bom podpisal, da je bilo to zaslišanje.
Podpisal je. Roka se mu ni tresla, pero pa je bilo Wynne Halloway, ker je svojega pustil v Carrowu.

**Hesk Tolliver**  
Družine jutri zvečer glasujejo po releju. Povedal jim bom, kaj sem videl in koliko ključev je potrebnih za odprtje omarice. Ne bom jim povedal, kaj naj storijo.

scenes.title: Zatišje
paragraphs: *Prvi mostovž, Brannock Yard · četrtek, 14:00 · Zatišje*

Na štiridesetih kilometrih je bil Carrow Shoal svetla skala, s katere je drselo šest prižganih vlačilcev, njihove rezalne roke pa so bile razprte kakor noge žuželk. Skali bosta to razdaljo držali šest ur. Yard je v oblekah stal vzdolž prvega mostovža: Svet, pazniki svetilk, Hesk Tolliver s palico, otrok na dostavnih saneh, ki so mu rekli, naj gre domov, pa je odklonil. Ferris Oake je stal ob vznožju mostovža s karabinko na rami in paznikom ob sebi. Orr je bila tam brez stranskega orožja, Wynne Halloway na njeni levi, v maršalkini roki pa svetilka, ker je nekdo vztrajal, da na prvem mostovžu nihče ne stoji v temi.
Vodilni vlačilec je poklical. Glas je bil Tamsin Veck.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Brannock Yard, tukaj Carrow Shoal. Družine so glasovale. Prebrala bom enkrat.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Prvič. Prebrali smo vseh devet. Hesk Tolliver hrani kopije v Registru Carrow, kjer jih nobena maršalka ne more izgubiti. Drugič. Ugotovitev Rote o Pellu velja kot prva svoje vrste, družine pa za stalno ohranijo stol v tisti sobi. Tretjič. Tessaly Orr stopi pred prvo Sodišče zaradi vseh devetih, do takrat pa po nobenem jašku ne hodi sama in ne nosi ničesar razen motilnika. Sila v Brannocku pripada Oakeovi straži in omarici z dvema ključema, za katero je Hesk videl, da sta jo Oake in tajnica Sveta odprla skupaj, en sam človek pa je ne more odpreti. Četrtič. Če se karkoli od tega zlomi, bomo znova prečkali in prihodnjič ne bomo najprej pozvonili.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Sprejeto. Vse štiri. Četrto bi napisala sama.
Na vodilnem vlačilcu so se rezalne roke zložile druga za drugo, nato pa počasi še na drugih petih.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Nisem ji odpustila. Hočem, da je to zapisano.

**Illuminara**  
Zapisano je. V zapisu Rote je bilo, še preden ste to povedali.

**Tamsin Veck**  
Dobro. Za popoldne bomo pristali. Naj nekdo pove Hesku Tolliverju, da lahko neha držati ograjo mostovža, kakor da mu dolguje denar.
Illuminara je tisti večer potrdila obrat in obrazec podpisala z opombo o ležaju.

Deset čez deset je Jašek Devet zamenjal posadko. Dve svetilki sta deset minut stali na drogu druga ob drugi, paznika pa sta govorila o ničemer posebnem, dokler se ni kletka dvignila. Orr je opazovala z ograje z drugo osebo ob sebi, ker je to zahteval tretji pogoj družin in ker ga je podpisala.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Enajst mesecev do Sodišča.

**Illuminara**  
Tam bom. V drugi vrsti, če jo dovolijo.

**Tessaly Orr**  
Druge vrste nimajo.

**Illuminara**  
Potem bom prinesla stol.
Pod njima je svetilka gorela in vrstica v registru pod nesrečami je ostala prazna.

translation_sl.critic_line: Maršalkino prikrito sabotiranje in razumljiv strah prisvojitelja rudarske pravice postaneta plačan zaščitni sistem z dvema ključema, ki so ga sooblikovale družine in ki ohrani pretok rude, ne da bi izbrisal devet smrti ali eni sami osebi izročil orožje.
